query: SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, ResourceAttributes['container.name'] AS container, substring(Body,1,1500) AS body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 15:33:00') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-12 15:40:00') AND ResourceAttributes['host.name']='nimbus-nimbusel-1' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name'] IN ('beacon','execution') AND (match(Body, '^(WRN|ERR|FAT)') OR Body LIKE '%engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV4%' OR Body LIKE '%[Ff]ailed%') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
